name: claude-code-rtl
description: Persian (and other right-to-left) text in the Claude Code chat: each block takes the direction of the language most of it is written in, code stays left-to-right, and Persian letters get the Vazirmatn font.

claudeRtl.font.patternErrorMessage: Use letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores.
claudeRtl.font.markdownDescription: Font for Persian, Arabic and Hebrew letters in the Claude Code chat. Bundled: `Vazirmatn`, `Parastoo`. Any other name uses an installed font of that name. `none` (or empty) keeps the font Claude Code and the system pick. Latin text is never affected. Reload the window after a change.

claudeRtl.autoApply.markdownDescription: Apply the patch on startup and again after Claude Code updates (an update replaces the patched file).
